quarterly_data.quarter: OE Solutions press release: OE Solutions Introduces 6W Industrial-Temperature 100G ZR (09-18-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: New product: a 6W industrial-temperature 100G ZR QSFP28 DCO (digital coherent optics) transceiver for mobile, MSO and other access networks. It supports 100GE and OTU4, full C-band tunability, a maximum power consumption of 6W across the full industrial temperature range, and drops into standard QSFP28 and QSFP-DD ports (legacy QSFP28 ports on switches and routers); reach up to 80 km/120 km (power-limited) and 500 km (noise-limited). The company is showcasing it at ECOC 2026 and will begin sampling its QSFP28 DCO modules to select customers in the fourth quarter of 2026, with general availability expected in the first half of 2027. CTO of Coherent Technology Kyu Hyun Kim: achieving a maximum power consumption of 6W over industrial temperatures is a milestone for deploying coherent optics at the network edge.
quarterly_data.figure: 6W max; 100G ZR QSFP28 DCO; reach 80 km/120 km and 500 km; sampling Q4 2026, general availability expected 1H 2027
